title: Bubbles Co-op: secondary animation (Episode 1)
brief_description: This film presents secondary school students’ animated films which were screened at the University of Melbourne “Bubbles Co-op” Film Festival. Indicates the range and depth of their concerns, imagination and considerable talents. A stimulating, amusing and refreshing compilation. Suitable for Upper Primary-Upper Secondary level students. No other credits available.
